title: Imp Patagium

sources.title: Ashes of Imp Patagium
markers: | description = '''Ashes of Imp Patagium''' is an [[Alchemy|Alchemical Extract]]. It can be combined with any [[Alchemy#Extractions|Essence]] to create {{SmRarityItem|Potion of Invisibility}}.

summary: Extract three Imp Patagia to make Ashes of Imp Patagium. Combine those Ashes with any Essence to brew Potion of Invisibility.

fields.Acquisition: Sold by Sticky Dondo in the Guildhall and Voiceless Penitent Bareki in the Undercity Ruins. Trader stock can renew on Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 9 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
